newsitem.title: UK: IPE Brent tumbles on technical selling.
newsitem.headline: IPE Brent tumbles on technical selling.

text.p: IPE Brent crude futures fell sharply on Thursday as a weak pre-expiry gas oil market pulled Brent down through technical support levels, traders said.
August Brent stood 25 cents a barrel lower at $17.97 while July gas oil, which expires today, was $1.75 down at $160.75.
"It is not news, it is just that gas oil fell back before the expiry and that dragged Brent down through a couple of stops," a broker said.
Dealers had earlier pegged technical support at $18.08 a barrel, the low point of business on Tuesday and Wednesday. Below that, technical analysts pegged support at $17.97.
The market briefly reached as low as $19.92 before recovering, to stand at $18.02 at 1003 GMT.
"This is fund selling, it is not fundamentally driven," another broker said.
